summary: Iter-8 full backend + frontend validation of the OOH/OSP dual-service reset. 18/18 backend tests PASS (pytest /app/backend/tests/test_ooh_flow.py). Frontend E2E of OOH planner up to /campagne/ooh/{id} detail page fully PASSES with live 24h countdown, checklist chips (Moduli/Documenti/Creativita/Pagamento), and Roma OOH modulo (descrizione_contenuto+settore_merceologico). SPID removed. Regression OSP holds (3 comuni, 4 spazi, wizard flow OK).

issues: Public /spazi still uses the previous drill-down UI (3 comuni cards visible immediately, spazi shown only after clicking a comune). Spec bullet says '3 comuni and 4 OSP area cards total' — semantically satisfied via drill-down but a flat view might be closer to spec wording. Backend confirms 4 OSP spazi exist (Roma 2, Milano 1, Napoli 1).

critical_code_review_comments: ooh.py `_impianti_bloccati` uses string compare `hold_expires_at > now` which is safe only because timestamps are ISO with same TZ suffix — OK today (all now_iso() are UTC ISO). Keep the invariant documented so nobody inserts a mixed-TZ record.

ooh.py `crea_campagna_ooh` post-insert conflict check uses `hold_created_at: {'$lt': hold_created}` — this correctly resolves the tie-breaker for race-condition inserts, but under very high concurrency two inserts with identical `hold_created` (same second) would both survive; consider adding a Mongo unique index on (impianti_ids, overlapping date) or a monotonic counter. Low priority given user scale.

server.py /comune/pratiche filter excludes ANNULLATA — good, but note the annulla_ooh only cancels pratiche in stato DA_COMPLETARE. If a pratica has been INVIATA and campaign.stato is not HOLD, annulla returns 400 — that is correct but the frontend Annulla button should be disabled after invia (verify in UI regression).
seed_demo.py DATASET file OK; keep in mind that reseeding wipes ALL pratiche — the reseed script deletes prenotazioni & pratiche globally, which is destructive if this DB were shared with production.
